text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, January 22, 2024, Appeal DDRT2024-04.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, and directed that the conditions of the Order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Tarundeep Singh and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before July 12, 2024.
